high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the user "rolaghora." The post features a person standing outdoors in front of a building with a decorative wrought iron gate. The individual is wearing a form-fitting, sheer black dress with a deep neckline and thin straps. The dress has a high slit on one side, revealing a glimpse of skin. The person is accessorized with a necklace and a bracelet. The background includes a beige wall with some greenery, including plants and vines. There is also a bird's nest hanging on the wall to the left of the person.
